High purity molybdenum and rhenium powders were used to prepare Mo and Mo–Re alloys via power metallurgy method. These powders processed via mixing, pressing and sintering to form as sintered Mo and Mo–Re alloys.
Thermal extrusion with ratio 4:1 was given at 1400 ◦C, to reduce geometrical size and improve mechanical properties.
Thermal annealing at 1100 ◦C was conducted for 2 h to relieve stresses and make Electron Backscatter Diffraction tests available.
